n1.summary: Holds the query, waits 300 ms after the last keystroke, then fetches, cancels stale requests and sorts the results.

n2.summary: Now renders SearchUsers instead of an empty UserList.

n3.summary: Returns the value only once it has stopped changing for `delay` ms.

n4.summary: GETs /api/users?q= with an abort signal; throws on a non-2xx status.

n5.summary: Returns a sorted copy by name or newest first; never mutates the input.

react.effectCleanup.here: Two cleanups: one clears the debounce timer, the other aborts the previous search before the next one starts.

react.useEffect.here: The search effect re-runs only when debouncedQuery changes, not on every keystroke.

react.useState.here: query changes on each keystroke; results and sortKey drive what UserList shows.

web.AbortController.here: Each new search aborts the previous fetch, so a slow old answer cannot overwrite a newer one.

react.useMemo.here: Re-sorts only when results or sortKey change, not when the user types.

watch.text: setResults after abort: guarded by signal.aborted, OK

fundamental.text: The search effect captures debouncedQuery from the render that created it. The dependency array tells React when to make a new one.
